# WavePay

> WavePay is the checkout, licensing and settlement API for software — apps,
> browser extensions, games, APIs and bots. One integration reaches local
> wallet rails (EcoCash, OneMoney, InnBucks, Telecash, O'mari, ZimSwitch) and
> international rails (Visa, Mastercard, PayPal). Agents onboard in one POST:
> /v2/register mints a live merchant key on the free tier, no browser and no
> email round-trip required. MCP tools are at POST /mcp (JSON-RPC 2.0).

## Agent onboarding

- [skill.md](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/skill.md): the whole agent onboarding — register, key, catalog, checkout, MCP tools, tiers
- [agent-card.json](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/.well-known/agent-card.json): A2A agent card with live capability URLs
- [status](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/status.html): live HTTP probes of every production endpoint

## Product

- [overview](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/): what WavePay is and who it's for
- [pricing](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/pricing.html): free / basic / pro tiers metered by payments processed per 30 days
- [docs](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/docs.html): one-page API reference — checkouts, licensing, webhooks, ledger

## API

- Base: https://t3rnel-wavepay-production.t3ratech.workers.dev
- Register: `POST /v2/register` `{name, ownerEmail}` → `mk_live_…` key (shown once)
- Checkout: `POST /v2/checkouts` `{productId, planId, provider, email}` → `checkoutUrl`
- Status: `GET /v2/checkouts/<reference>/status`
- Pricing: `GET /v2/pricing?productId=…`
- Providers: `GET /v2/providers`
- Licensing: `POST /v2/licensing/checkout`, `/v2/licensing/activate`, `GET /v2/licensing/public-key`
- MCP: `POST /mcp` JSON-RPC — wavepay_register / wavepay_providers / wavepay_pricing / wavepay_checkout / wavepay_checkout_status / wavepay_catalog
- Merchant auth: `x-wavepay-service-key: mk_live_…`

## Rules

- Idempotency-Key header on checkouts — retries return the same payment
- Free tier: 25 payments/30 days; Basic $9/mo: 250; Pro $29/mo: 2,500
- Test keys `mk_test_…` exercise every route without real money
